claims.headline_claim: Prompt 4 reduced total input prompt tokens from 1,833 to 1,304 (-28.86%) on the EduPath Mini task.
Total end-to-end latency reduced by 2.04% (18,262.04 ms to 17,889.21 ms); input token efficiency does not yield proportional end-to-end speedup because 512-token generation dominates runtime.
claims.systems_explanation: On local GPU inference (RTX 3050), output generation (~17 seconds, ~95% of runtime) dwarfs prompt evaluation (~368 ms to 666 ms, ~2-4% of runtime). A 28.86% input token reduction bounds prompt eval load, but total latency is strictly bounded by autoregressive token generation.

claims.headline_claim: Selective tool schema injection reduced prompt tool descriptions from 20 tools (657 tokens, 2,909 chars) to 4 tools (154 tokens, 723 chars), achieving a 76.56% token reduction.
claims.security_authorization_invariant: Runtime authorization (PermissionGate, _REGISTRY, get_tool) remains fully active. Selective injection only controls visibility in prompt text.

claims.headline_claim: Static prompt prefix is 100% hash-stable across turns (hash f2f5a3b9...); direct KV cache reuse latency speedup was not observed in Ollama trial B.
claims.cache_observation_details: Experiment B prompt-eval latency was 1,071.02 ms vs baseline 368.48 ms. Prefix stability is a structural prerequisite for KV cache reuse, but Ollama did not exhibit runtime prompt-eval latency reduction under this single-process test harness.

claims.headline_claim: Query keyword relevance filtering and content deduplication reduced memory injection from 1 unrelated fact to 0 facts for the EduPath Mini task.
claims.policy: Query keyword overlap + normalized content deduplication + top-5 cap

claims.headline_claim: Progressive skill disclosure provides up to 82.55% character reduction under Level 1 (summary), while Level 2 prunes code blocks; in react-frontend (0 code blocks), Level 2 maintains full procedural text.
claims.explanation: Level 2 procedural pruning targets markdown code blocks. For skills with substantial code samples, Level 2 significantly reduces tokens. For react-frontend, which contains zero code fences, Level 2 leaves the text unchanged.

claims.headline_claim: Benchmark mode is strictly isolated from production prompt optimizations; when execution_mode is benchmark, all 20 tools, full memory, Level 3 skills, and legacy role format are unconditionally preserved.
All 228 canonical unit tests, 96 focused Prompt 3 tests, and 9 Prompt 4 tests pass with zero regressions.
